description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySession functionality within the openclaw project, focusing on URL formatting, timeout resolution, and URL rewriting functions.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTimeoutTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for Gateway session timeout and URL handling functions.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests proper formatting of gateway authority strings with IPv6 addresses enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests URL construction for WebSocket with IPv6 addresses, with and without TLS.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_normalizesPersistedBracketedIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests normalization of URLs with bracketed IPv6 hosts that are already formatted.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesFloorWhenMissingOrTooSmall
methods.description: Ensures timeout values default to a minimum when null or too small.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesInvokeBudgetWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks that the timeout respects the specified bounds.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_capsAtUpperBound
methods.description: Verifies that the timeout caps at a maximum value.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesTerminalCapabilitySegment
methods.description: Tests URL rewriting to replace the terminal capability segment.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesWhenQueryAndFragmentPresent
methods.description: Tests URL rewriting when query parameters and fragment are present.
